transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

I guess… I’m here because I keep getting up when I’m supposed to stay seated. Like during client interviews, tutoring sessions, even book club. People have started noticing that I can’t just sit and listen.
Do you feel restless or have an urge to move even when you know you should stay seated?

Yes. I mean… that’s kind of the issue. I’ll be in a client interview or a tutoring session, somewhere I know I’m supposed to stay seated, and I still end up getting up. Even at book club. People have started noticing I can’t just sit and listen.
Do you often feel restless or have trouble staying still even in situations where it’s not necessary to move, like when you're relaxing at home?

Yeah. Even when I’m home and there’s nothing urgent, I don’t really… settle. I’ll go from unpacking boxes to reorganizing case files to running errands, like I’m still chasing something. It’s hard for me to just be off duty.
Do these feelings of restlessness or the need to keep moving happen in other situations as well, like when you're at home alone or trying to read a book?

Yeah. On days I don’t have field work, I still don’t really stay put. I’ll go from unpacking boxes to reorganizing case files to running errands… like I’m chasing a lead, even when I’m not. It’s hard to just be off duty.
Looking back, did you experience similar feelings of restlessness or difficulty staying seated when you were a child or teenager?

Yes. My report cards from grade school pretty much said the same thing over and over—bright, but couldn’t stay in my seat or wait my turn. My mother still jokes that I treated every classroom like a crime scene I needed to pace through.

latest_inference.note: The patient's symptoms of persistent restlessness, difficulty staying seated, and a need to be constantly moving, both in structured situations and at home, along with a lifelong pattern dating back to childhood, strongly support a diagnosis of ADHD, predominantly hyperactive-impulsive type.
